name: IndiaNivesh Limited
about: IndiaNivesh Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. It operates in three segments: Investment & Trading in Shares & Securities, Finance and Other Activities, and Broking and Other Activities. The company involves in the provision of investing and financing activities; and acquisition and management of stressed assets, as well as provides consultancy services. It also provides brokerage and distribution services in equities, derivatives, currencies, commodities, mutual funds, initial public offering/OFS, insurance, and loan against securities and margin trade funding; and private wealth services comprising customized solutions, mutual funds, and wealth cafe. In addition, the company offers portfolio management services, private equity, and strategic investments; institutional equities, such as research, and sales and trading; and investment banking and corporate advisory comprising capital raise, India entry, globalization of Indian companies, and mergers and acquisitions. IndiaNivesh Limited was incorporated in 1931 and is based in Mumbai, India.
